title: Construct lossless updates from explicit engineering decisions
statement: The system shall construct complete recording candidates from explicitly targeted actor decisions while preserving omitted semantic content, identities and unrelated records, composing only compatible requested edits, and offering equivalent non-writing preview without requiring callers to build storage scaffolding.

what.problem: Reconstructing storage representations or inferring defaults can overwrite neighboring decisions or refresh assessment bases without an actor decision.
what.desired_outcome: Actors can supply a bounded meaningful edit or batch and see exactly its intended candidate effects without hidden semantic changes.

why.rationale: Narrow, lossless authoring makes correction practical while retaining the integrity of recorded judgments and unrelated work.

stakeholders: Engineers and reviewers operating on recorded engineering work
Engineering agents acting on explicit actor decisions
Maintainers and consumers of the published command-line interface

conditions: During explicit targeted or complete record updates, batch preparation and non-writing previews.

contexts: Named entries and fields in one selected supported change store; candidate construction operates on one coherent before-state.

how.approach: Construct the complete candidate from explicitly supplied edits, generating only mechanical storage metadata. Preserve omitted records, values, narrative, ordering and identities; require new-record applicability and validate final references. Preserve exact external evidence bytes where their digest is part of retained identity.

how_much.scope: Explicit targeted and complete record updates and bounded batch composition. Operational serialization is implementation-owned; preserved semantic narrative and ordered values are not permission to rewrite original evidence artifacts. No arbitrary repository patch, implicit deletion, cross-Change batch or automatic retry merge is introduced.

acceptance_criteria: The actor supplies required semantic inputs; the tool constructs identities and storage bookkeeping without requiring directories, manifests or database fields from callers.

Only explicitly selected values and necessary metadata change. Omitted fields and unrelated records remain unchanged. Explicit replacement of comparable working information is permitted; attachments still supporting retained conclusions cannot silently change meaning.

A task submission constructs one coherent candidate containing its related facts. Same-request references resolve before publication; conflicting assignments reject. This does not require a public arbitrary batch interface.

Current evidence and assessment accounts may be replaced through their owning tasks without permanent predecessor chains. Retain open findings until explicit disposition, the attribution and basis of judgments still relied upon, and compact completed accounts. Progress updates cannot create reviewer judgments or widen authority.

Preview validates the same intended semantic candidate without authoritative writes, persistent reservations or a saved claim. Execution checks freshness again and does not treat preview as authority.

Unavailable known records or occupied destinations cannot be treated as empty creation targets. Explicit restoration remains subject to its own supported operation and normal integrity, authority and conflict checks.
constraints: Current allocations and source-observed facets describe v4 SQLite. Source availability does not establish passing execution, project adoption or requirement satisfaction; historical v3 contribution arguments retain their original subjects.
